newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.120pts to 102.499.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.120pts to 102.499.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.120 points in Tuesday's trading to 102.499, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.002 points to 2.362 years.
The index can also be found on Reuters page .BICS.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.182 points to 99.155 points, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.002 points to 2.228 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 5.006 points to 1,069.079.
